objective: Automate and optimize the Pulmuone New Audit Request process using AI Agents to reduce review lead time and minimize human error regarding hurdle conditions.

phases.action: Stakeholder identifies supplier and requests Sourcing Portal signup.
Supplier registers/updates information on Sourcing Portal.
Create Audit Request on Portal (Logic: PB via Messenger/Email, MG direct).
Submit Audit Request Form with supporting documents.
Review submitted documents against Hurdle conditions.
Conduct site audit and final determination.

hurdle_conditions.name: Quality Certification
hurdle_conditions.requirement: Mandatory HACCP certification (GMP for health functional foods).

hurdle_conditions.name: Foreign Object Control
hurdle_conditions.requirement: Operation of metal detectors or X-ray equipment is mandatory.

hurdle_conditions.name: Raw Material Regulation
hurdle_conditions.requirement: Strict prohibition of unpasteurized liquid egg usage.

hurdle_conditions.name: Building Legality
hurdle_conditions.requirement: No illegal or undeclared temporary buildings/structures.

hurdle_conditions.name: Subcontracting Prohibition
hurdle_conditions.requirement: Direct manufacturing only; subcontracted production is prohibited.

agent_roles.action: Monitor requests and automatically trigger portal signup guides.
Real-time OCR verification of HACCP/Equipment certs and feedback.
Automatically validate hurdle conditions before final submission.
Generate summary reports for S&A team, highlighting priority risks.
Track 1-year re-audit ban for failed suppliers and manage timelines.

business_rules.failure_penalty: If 'Unacceptable', 1-year ban on same manufacturing site re-request.
business_rules.request_window: Audit request recommended within 1 month of production readiness.
business_rules.exception_rule: Skip audit if same process/line with verified evidence or recognized certs (List A).
